rows.note: Use 沿住 A as the all-purpose choice for moving or extending alongside a line, edge, or route.

example.english: Walk along the river and you’ll see the pier.
example.traditional: 沿住條河一路行，就會見到個碼頭。
example.jyutping: jyun4 zyu6 tiu4 ho4 jat1 lou6 haang4 zau6 wui5 gin3 dou2 go3 maa5 tau4

rows.note: Use 順住 A when the emphasis is on proceeding in the direction of a route.

example.english: Go along this road and you’ll get there.
example.traditional: 順住呢條路一直行，就到喇。
example.jyutping: seon6 zyu6 ni1 tiu4 lou6 jat1 zik6 haang4 zau6 dou3 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when people do something together, as in singing along.
Use this when someone is told to carry on with an action or move onward, as in 繼續行.
